transactions.title: Rental, authorized by an on-chain proof
transactions.claim: The holder rents right #3 to the renter until 2026-11-28. The contract verifies the ownership proof on chain; the holder's signature is the only one.
transactions.look_for: Status: success. One signature, the holder's — no issuer. The call's last two arguments are the proof and its eleven public signals.

transactions.title: Sale, authorized by an on-chain proof
transactions.claim: The holder sells right #1 to the buyer. The proof also computes the buyer's new commitment, which replaces the old one, so only the buyer can prove next.
transactions.look_for: Status: success. Two signatures — the holder's over the whole call, the buyer's over the right id and the buyer's secret hash. No issuer. The transfer event's commitment is the new one.

transactions.title: Tampered proof — rejected on chain
transactions.claim: A valid rental of right #4 with two of the proof's points swapped. Every public signal matches the transfer, so every check passes up to the pairing check, which fails.
transactions.look_for: Status: failed, result invoke_host_function_trapped. The diagnostic events end in Error(Contract, #28) — InvalidProof.

transactions.title: Replayed proof — rejected on chain
transactions.claim: Transaction 1's call, resubmitted unchanged: the same proof, the same signals. Its nullifier was spent by transaction 1.
transactions.look_for: Status: failed, result invoke_host_function_trapped. Error(Contract, #27) — NullifierUsed. Compare its arguments with transaction 1's: identical.

transactions.title: Proof from the wrong account — rejected on chain
transactions.claim: The renter signs and submits the owner's valid proof for right #4 as if it were theirs. The proof names the owner's account.
transactions.look_for: Status: failed, result invoke_host_function_trapped. Error(Contract, #21) — WrongAccount. The source account is the renter.

transactions.title: Holder and issuer sign, no proof — rejected on chain
transactions.claim: Phase 1's full authorization for a sale of right #2: the holder's signature and the issuer's. No proof. Under Phase 2 the issuer's signature counts for nothing.
transactions.look_for: Status: failed, result invoke_host_function_trapped. Two authorization entries — the holder's and the issuer's — and Error(Contract, #16): no public signals, so no proof.

transactions.title: Issuer transferring a held week to itself — rejected on chain
transactions.claim: The issuer builds, signs and pays for a transfer of right #2 from its holder to itself. It has neither the holder's signature nor the holder's secret.
transactions.look_for: Status: failed, result invoke_host_function_trapped. Source account: the issuer. Error(Auth, InvalidAction) — the holder never authorized it, so nothing past the first check ran.
